content: Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

7SABER is a brand developed by the London Institute of Identity (INSTID) and Tashkent agency GRANDPR, officially launched on June 25, 2021. One of the products available is the Saber Sneakers, which have a vendor code of 124-SN-U-02 and are priced at $86. They come in various colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. The sizes available range from 41 to 48.
